label: Formulated and codified the Principle of Utility and felicific calculus
description: Jeremy Bentham formulated and introduced the concept of "Principle of Utility", which became a seminal contribution in ethics philosophy.
dialecticalTension: Formulating an epistemic apparatus to resolve central problems in ethics.
historicalContext: Introduced during the Enlightenment & Social Contract as part of Jeremy Bentham's canonical writings.

label: Direct pedagogical mentor and patron to Mill, establishing the utilitarian foundation that Mill subsequently refined into qualitative liberalism
description: John Stuart Mill adopted Jeremy Bentham's insights and systematically extended them into new metaphysical, ethical, or epistemological domains.
dialecticalTension: Negotiating the intellectual shift from Jeremy Bentham's perspective to John Stuart Mill's reconstructed system.
historicalContext: Inter-epochal reception: transmitting insights from the Enlightenment & Social Contract across history into the 19th Century Divergences.
